author: Maksym Kozlenko
attribution: Photo: Maksym Kozlenko, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:2019-01-28_Sigatoka_market,_Fiji_7.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Red hanging shop sign under a verandah by Sigatoka market; Fijian 'sitoa ni naova' = clothing store. Distractors: 'Digicel top up here', 'vodafone Recharge Here', 'JEWELLERY COSMETICS', '...CLOTHING WHOLESALERS & DISTRIBUTORS LTD', big 'PHARMACY' fascia across the street, 'Drua' and 'OUR MARKET OUR IMAGE' signs; market vendors incidental. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Yuko Hara from Yokohama, Japan
attribution: Photo: Yuko Hara from Yokohama, Japan, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Fiji_Museum_in_Suva.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Bilingual English/Fijian name board over a painted rainforest mural at the Fiji Museum, Suva, shot from below at an angle; Fijian text is small capitals with larger initials. Small plaque on the mural ('ERECTED BY ... 1974') is illegible.

author: Maksym Kozlenko
attribution: Photo: Maksym Kozlenko, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Nadi_airport_-_Vodafone_office.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Illuminated red fascia of the Vodafone shop in the Nadi International Airport terminal. Distractor posters: 'Phone service just like home?', 'PICK UP YOUR FREE SIM HERE!', multilingual greetings wall ('Bula', 'Namaste', ...). location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Maksym Kozlenko
attribution: Photo: Maksym Kozlenko, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Suva,_Fiji_88.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-painted green shop board in Suva, shot at a steep angle with a wide lens; the 's' after ESHAAN is a small raised letter, and the end of BARGAIN may be cut by peeling paint. Lower lines are badly peeled (approx. 'SANDALS', 'BRAS', 'UNDER GARMENTS', '...FLOOR UPSTAIRS') and are left out. Distractor 'Comfort Home' hanging sign further along; shoppers and a van with plate incidental. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Rickard Törnblad
attribution: Photo: Rickard Törnblad, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Shop_in_Lautoka,_Viti_Levu,_Fiji_-_August_2016.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Red hanging fast-food sign along a shop arcade in Lautoka, at an angle with a cable across it. The large yellow 'SuperFoods / On your way home' fascia at left is cut off at the top ('...perFoods') and is a distractor, as are 'SHAH'S FASTFOOD & RESTAURANT' wall sign, Punjas 'Scotch Finger', Digicel and Coca-Cola signs; shoppers incidental. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:Shop in Lautoka, Viti Levu, Fiji - August 2016.jpg

author: Maksym Kozlenko
attribution: Photo: Maksym Kozlenko, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Nadi_27.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.

lines.text: ナンディ・ハンディクラフト・センター

notes: Curved blue fascia with serif English letters and Japanese katakana below (middle dots as separators), Nadi town centre; shot from below with a wide lens. Two musicians in the doorway and shoppers incidental; 'gaan', 'Digicel', 'FOREIGN EXCHANGE' signs down the street are distractors. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: User:Matthias Süßen
attribution: Photo: User:Matthias Süßen, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:GPH_Suva_MatthiasSuessen-8547.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Black decorative lettering on the glass entrance door of the Grand Pacific Hotel, Suva, with an ornament between the lines; a blurred doorman silhouette (seen from behind) and the street are visible through the glass. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: OhanaUnited Talk page
attribution: Photo: OhanaUnited Talk page, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Nausori_Airport_sign.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Entrance sign under a pavilion roof at Nausori airport, shot from a moving car (slight motion blur). The 'FIJI AIRPORTS' logo text is tiny. GIVE WAY sign and blurred bollard in front are distractors. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Jaejay77
attribution: Photo: Jaejay77, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Bakery_Lomaloma.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Red roadside bakery sign on two white posts in Lomaloma, Vanua Balavu; 'THE HOT' is stacked small to the left of BREAD. A shop worker stands by the door (incidental). Small poster on the post ('Cream Buns...') is a distractor.

author: Melbar
attribution: Photo: Melbar, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:General_Store_Levuka.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Red painted lettering on the yellow weatherboard facade of the historic general store in Levuka (Ovalau). 'Westpac THE BANK' sign under the verandah is a secondary sign; people on the verandah incidental. The name is generic, so the query is weak on its own.

author: User:Matthias Süßen
attribution: Photo: User:Matthias Süßen, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Flea_Market_Suva_MatthiasSuessen-8917.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Colourful 'Suva!' letter board above the 'FLEA MARKET' lettering at the market entrance, Suva. A bilingual English/Fijian NOTICE board on the steps (small text) and 'FIJI' sarongs are distractors; people sitting on the steps incidental. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_categories: Photographs of flags of Fiji in Suva

author: M K
attribution: Photo: M K, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Yako,_Fiji_-_panoramio.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: White village-name plate under a 50 km/h sign on the Queens Road near Nadi, seen through a windscreen from a distance; decorative metal gateway posts flank the road. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
